title: Minerals and Mining
workflow_rule: Every printed page was manually read and every explanatory sentence and table row in the integrated notes was manually written and judged. No prose or question text was mechanically generated, bulk-paraphrased or template-built. Scripts are limited to inventory, anchor/count/hash validation and tests.
coverage_method: Each intake fact retains its page-local ordinal. Page anchors teach the complete page intake; overlapping claims are corrected beside the printed claim. Structured records and visuals are represented by prose, tables or explicit reading guidance.
